office_does: The Prosecuting Attorney prosecutes crimes in Mason County and is the civil lawyer for county government.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Michael Dorcy (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Mason County Prosecuting Attorney since 2011 and a deputy prosecutor there before that; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Prosecuting Attorney since January 2011; deputy prosecutor 2004-2010 [S1][S2]
Names indigent defense funding and availability as the office's primary issue [S1]
Promises a 'firm and fair' approach and closer work with law enforcement [S1]
